URGENT CARE ATTENDING NOTE
JOEL PAUL POLIZZI
MRN: 17948266
DOB: 6/28/1986
PMD: No Pcp, Per Patient
CC: Sinus Problem (Sinus congestion x 5 days )
[table#1]:
| **Chief Complaint** |
| --- |
| Patient presents with |
| • | Sinus Problem |
| | | *Sinus congestion x 5 days * |
HPI: Joel Paul Polizzi is a 36 year old male has a past medical history of Tinnitus. who presents with **sinus congestion x 5days. Patient reports multiple negative COVID test patient denies any fevers patient denies any green sputum production patient reports some mild postnasal drip. The patient reports that he is allergic to penicillin.**
PMHx: see hpi
PSHx: has a past surgical history that includes Ankle hardware implantation (Right, 03/2011) and Colonoscopy (07/27/2020).
Shx: reports that he has been smoking cigarettes. He has a 5.00 pack-year smoking history. He has never used smokeless tobacco. He reports current alcohol use. He reports current drug use. Drug: Marijuana.
FamHx: family history includes Cancer in his maternal grandmother and paternal grandfather; Dementia in his paternal grandmother; No Known Problems in his brother, brother, father, and maternal grandfather; Thyroid in his mother.
Meds: has a current medication list which includes the following prescription(s): azithromycin.
ALL: Penicillins
ROS:
all other systems reviewed and negative as per my custom and practice for the above complaint
EXAM
BP 142/79 (BP Location: Left arm, BP Patient Position: Sitting, BP cuff size: Regular) | Pulse 95 | Temp 98.6 °F (37 °C) (Oral) | Resp 16 | SpO2 96%
GEN: NAD a&o nontoxic well appearing
HEENT: anicteric, MMM mild pharyngeal erythema no exudates no tonsillar swelling no lymphadenopathy
NECK: Normal ROM no jvd, no stiffness
LUNGS: no respiratory distress
EXT: normal ROM all joints
SKIN: no rash or lesions
NEURO: normal mentation, speech, and gait
A/P: Discussed plan of care with patient. Offered viral testing we discussed risks and benefits of antibiotics symptoms most likely viral patient reports he will wait an additional 5 days and if symptoms have not resolved then only he will take antibiotics patient reports allergy to penicillin but agreeable to Z-Pak

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **1.** | **Sinusitis, unspecified chronicity, unspecified location ** | **J32.9** | **473.9** | **azithromycin (ZITHROMAX) 250 MG tablet** |
| |
**MEDICATIONS PRESCRIBED (FOR DISCHARGED ED PATIENTS)**
I discussed with patient the nature of this patient's illness/problem, results of all resulted tests, course of treatment, and prospects for recovery/follow up care needs. patient verbalized understanding and agreement with plan. All questions answered.
Parameters of returning to ED/UC also discussed with patient, who voiced understanding.
The patient understands to return immediately if the symptoms worsen or new symptoms develop. Additionally, the patient will return if symptoms persist.
Electronically signed by Rachna A Subramony at 12/01/2022 6:28 PM PST
